# Health Club (হেলথ ক্লাব) — Healthcare Discount & Medical Services Platform in Feni, Bangladesh

> Health Club (https://healthclubfeni.com) is a digital healthcare membership and medical services platform based in Feni, Bangladesh. It provides 10% to 30% medical discounts on hospital admissions, diagnostic lab tests, surgeries, and pharmacy bills across an extensive network of contracted hospitals, diagnostic centers, and clinics. Health Club also operates a 24/7 emergency ambulance network, voluntary blood donor directory, specialist doctors directory, interactive clinical health assessment tools, and preventative health guides for all 6 Upazilas of Feni District and Greater Chittagong.

## Quick Facts & Contact Information
- **Official Website**: https://healthclubfeni.com
- **Helpline & Emergency Support**: +880 1886763849
- **Official Email**: healthclubfeni@gmail.com
- **Headquarters**: Feni, Chittagong Division, Bangladesh
- **Supported Languages**: Bengali (বাংলা), English
- **Primary Geographic Scope**: Feni District (all 6 Upazilas) & Greater Chittagong Division

## Full Coverage of all 6 Feni Upazilas (৬টি উপজেলা)
Health Club operates across the entire Feni District, connecting residents, emergency responders, and healthcare providers:
1. **Feni Sadar (ফেনী সদর)**: Central medical hub, 250-bed general hospital area, SSK Road clinics, diagnostic centers, specialist chambers, and ambulance stands.
2. **Chhagalnaiya (ছাগলনাইয়া)**: Local clinics, diagnostic labs, emergency ambulance support, and active voluntary blood donor network.
3. **Daganbhuiyan (দাগনভূঞা)**: Partner medical centers, pharmacies, maternal health support, and blood donors.
4. **Sonagazi (সোনাগাজী)**: Coastal region medical support, emergency patient transportation, and lab test discounts.
5. **Parshuram (পরশুরাম)**: Border region healthcare facilities, emergency transit to Feni Sadar/Chittagong, and local donor coverage.
6. **Fulgazi (ফুলগাজী)**: Upazila health network, emergency response, diagnostic discounts, and community healthcare access.

## Core Services & Platform Features

### 1. Digital Membership & Hospital Discounts (`/membership`, `/partner-hospitals`)
- **Digital Health Card**: Instant mobile card with scannable QR code and unique Member ID (`HC-YYYY-XXXXX`).
- **Diagnostic Discounts**: 10% to 30% discount on pathology (blood tests, lipid, liver/kidney function, hormone assays) and radiology (X-ray, USG, CT scan, MRI, ECG, Echo).
- **Hospital Admissions**: 10% to 20% discount on hospital cabin rent, bed charges, and post-operative care at partner hospitals.
- **Pharmacies**: 5% to 10% discount on genuine medicines at partner model pharmacies.
- **Family Coverage**: Single membership card covers the member, spouse, dependent children, and parents.

### 2. 24/7 Emergency Services & Blood Network (`/emergency`)
- **Ambulance Fleet Directory**: Instant contact with drivers across all 6 upazilas for AC Ambulances, Non-AC Ambulances, ICU Support Ambulances (with ventilator & oxygen for critical transfers to Chittagong/Dhaka), and Freezer/Mortuary Vans.
- **Voluntary Blood Donor Network**: Verified directory of local blood donors covering all 8 blood groups (A+, A-, B+, B-, O+, O-, AB+, AB-) with Upazila filtering and real-time availability status.
- **Emergency Helplines**: Quick-dial access to National Emergency (999), National Health Hotline (16263), Feni Sadar Hospital Emergency, and Fire Service.
- **Emergency First-Aid Protocols**: Fast clinical guides for CPR, cardiac emergencies, acute bleeding, burn management, and snakebites.

### 3. Specialist Doctors Directory (`/consultants`)
- **Specialist Search & Filters**: Search doctors by medical specialty (Medicine, Cardiology, Gynecology & Obstetrics, Pediatrics, Orthopedics, ENT, Dermatology, Eye, Surgery, Gastroenterology, Neurology, Urology, etc.) and Upazila.
- **Doctor Profiles**: Detailed educational degrees (MBBS, FCPS, MD, MS, MRCP), hospital affiliations, chamber addresses, visiting days/hours, appointment serial phone numbers, and member discount eligibility.

### 4. Interactive Health Assessment Tools (`/health-tools`)
- **BMI Calculator**: Body Mass Index calculator with Asian-specific WHO risk categories and ideal weight recommendations.
- **Blood Pressure Risk Evaluator**: ACC/AHA classification (Normal, Elevated, Stage 1, Stage 2, Hypertensive Crisis) with actionable clinical advice.
- **Diabetes & Glucose Evaluator**: ADA-standard evaluation for Fasting (FPG), Postprandial (PPG), and Random (RBS) blood sugar readings with hypoglycemia/hyperglycemia alerts.
- **Pregnancy Due Date Calculator**: Estimated Date of Delivery (EDD) based on Naegele's rule, gestational age tracker, trimester timeline, and Antenatal Care (ANC) checkup calendar.
- **Daily Calorie Calculator**: Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) and Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) calculator based on Mifflin-St Jeor formula.
- **Daily Water Intake Calculator**: Personalized daily hydration goals calculated from body weight, climate temperature, and physical activity level.
- **Health Report PDF Export**: One-click printable PDF health summary for medical consultations.

### 5. Preventative Health Guides & Articles (`/health-tips`)
- Doctor-reviewed preventative articles covering chronic disease management, pediatric health, maternal wellness, cardiac care, dietary advice, and seasonal illness prevention.

## Membership Pricing Tiers
- **Founding Member (ফাউন্ডিং মেম্বার)**: **FREE (৳0 for 1 Year)** for the first 100 registered members. Full family discount coverage included.
- **Premium Member (প্রিমিয়াম মেম্বার)**: **৳500 / Year**. Full family coverage, priority partner discounts, 24/7 hotline support.

## How Verification Works at Hospitals
1. Member presents their digital card on mobile at the hospital or diagnostic center billing counter.
2. Hospital billing staff scans the card's QR code or searches the Member ID on the Health Club Partner Verification Portal (`/verify?id=...`).
3. Active status and eligible discounts are confirmed instantly, and the discount is deducted before payment.
